presentations.name: Concealed
presentations.description: Hides a node until it is stopped; the node then fades in. Start it on the nodes a map reveals one by one.

presentations.name: Lift
presentations.description: Raises a node a little for as long as it plays: a hover's answer.

presentations.name: Pulse
presentations.description: Dims a node and lets it come back, once: a click's answer.
